content.summary: Bosch BBS1041GQC הוא שואב אבק אלחוטי עם סוללה נשלפת 18V בקיבולת 4.0Ah מסדרת Power for ALL. זמן העבודה מגיע עד 80 דקות במצב Eco ללא מברשת חשמלית ועד 65 דקות עם מברשת חשמלית, והטעינה המלאה נמשכת 65 דקות. המוט הגמיש Flex Tube מתכופף ב-90° לשאיבה מתחת לרהיטים, ומתאים למי שמחפש שואב אלחוטי לניקוי שוטף של כל הבית.

reviewFlags.issue: Catalog says German design and motor. Bug.co.il lists the product as made in Poland (תוצרת פולין), with only the motor described as German. Confirm the origin text before publishing.

Warranty sources conflict. Traklin says one year by the official importer (BSH) plus a note, while Bug says two years plus 8 years on the motor, and Coolblue (not used as evidence) also says two years. Confirm the Israeli warranty term with BSH.

Weight sources conflict. The nl-NL spec sheet gives 2.9 kg ready to use with tube and floor nozzle, while Israeli retailers give 3.7 kg ready to use. The published value uses the Israeli 3.7 kg figure.
HEPA efficiency conflicts. Bug and the spec sheet say above 99.99%, while Traklin says above 99.9%. The catalog's 99.99% is supported by Bug, but the conflict should be checked.

Dimensions come only from the nl-NL spec sheet (height 1300 mm, width 250 mm, depth 216 mm) and are not stated on the Israeli pages. A 1300 mm height is unusually tall for a stick vacuum, so confirm whether this is the full extended length.
Israeli retailers reportedly state different warranty terms (Traklin vs Bug); warranty not published until confirmed with BSH.
Israeli retailer gives 3.7 kg ready to use; the nl-NL spec sheet reportedly gives 2.9 kg. Confirm which applies.
Catalog says German design and motor; Bug lists made in Poland with German motor. Confirm origin text.
Height 1300 mm from spec sheet may be full extended length; confirm.
Catalog HEPA 99.99% claim not verified by kept facts; Traklin reportedly says 99.9%.
